title: RSC mode lacks version skew detection (non-RSC mode has it since v7.3)
author: agcty
body_preview: I know RSC is still `unstable_` -- this is just for tracking, not a demand for immediate action.  The non-RSC framework mode detects version mismatches via `X-Remix-Reload-Document` on `/__manifest` requests and triggers a full page reload with sessionStorage loop prevention (added in #13061). The RSC code path has none of this.  When a new deployment happens while a user has a stale client loaded...
